abstract: RNA velocity can predict the direction of cell-state change, but the regulatory programs shaping these changes remain difficult to identify. In this issue of Cell, Wang et al. introduce RegVelo, a framework that integrates gene regulatory networks into RNA velocity analysis to nominate candidate regulators that may bias cell fate.
